NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以CUDA平台和全栈软硬件协同打造数据中心级AI基础设施，赋能各行业AI应用。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Builds data center-scale AI infrastructure with the CUDA platform and full-stack co-designed hardware and software.
concrete_bets: Extreme co-design of chips, networking, systems, software

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 负责任地让AI惠及大众，以Microsoft Cloud全栈AI平台和Copilot智能体提升生产力。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Democratize responsible AI across the full stack, led by Microsoft Cloud platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot agents.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将生成式AI模型与企业本体及现有平台集成，实现企业和政府领域的负责任AI优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI models with enterprise ontology and existing platforms via AIP for responsible AI advantage across enterprise and government.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AI投资赋能社交产品、Meta AI助手与AI眼镜，并布局下一代计算平台
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Invest in AI to power social products, the Meta AI assistant, and AI glasses, while building the next computing platform.
concrete_bets: Meta AI assistant across apps, web, and AI glasses
AI-driven content ranking and discovery engine
Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Simon Willison集中发布Datasette及其地理、图表、地图、Agent与LLM插件的一批小版本更新。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Simon Willison ships a batch of Datasette core and geospatial, charting, agent and LLM plugin releases.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Raschka从位置嵌入、推理模型课程、文本分类、循环Transformer到Claude水印等解释LLM内部机制。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Raschka explains LLM internals from positional embeddings and reasoning-model courses to text classification, looped transformers and Claude watermarks.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: HuggingFace博客围绕llama.cpp v1.0、LLMON标记语言、嵌入池化、端侧小模型、3D微调与Hub计费等本地开源工程话题。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: HuggingFace posts cover local open-source engineering: llama.cpp v1.0, LLMON markup, embedding pooling, on-device small models, 3D fine-tuning and Hub billing.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: OpenAI新闻集中于科学博客、ChatGPT Wallet及Shield、Amplitude、Gondola、Holiday Extras等企业用Codex/Agent提升生产力与安全研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI news centers on a science blog, ChatGPT Wallet, plus Shield, Amplitude, Gondola and Holiday Extras using Codex/agents for enterprise productivity and safety research.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: Google Research与BAIR展示可穿戴CKM风险、血压检测、TB筛查、超声母胎护理、语言探索及LLM持续学习等科学健康应用。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Google Research and BAIR showcase wearables CKM risk, hypertension, TB screening, maternal ultrasound, language exploration and continual learning for science and health.

alias.notes: All raw themes mapped to known canonicals. Spelling variants and related concepts folded: Enterprise AI Platform and Foundation Models under LLM/生成式AI应用; AI系统可观测性 and Token/成本可观测 under AI系统可观测性/成本; Prompt injection/AI安全 under AI安全/Responsible AI; both AI coding agent skill variants under AI编码agent当硬技能; 企业数据上的应用LLM under LLM/生成式AI应用.
